mapper.sql: sb2c.id, sb2c.code, sb2c.dict_platform as dictPlatform, sb2c.platform_code as platformCode, sb2c.shop_id as shopId, sb2c.approve_status as approveStatus, sb2c.pay_status as payStatus, sb2c.bill_status as billStatus, sb2c.invalid_status as invalidStatus, sb2c.amount as amount, sb2c.currency as currency, sb2c.pay_time as payTime, sb2c.buyer_remark as buyerRemark, sb2c.remark as remark, sb2c.abnormal_type as abnormalType, sb2cl.dict_logistics_method as dictLogisticsMethod, case when sb2cl.actual_shipping_cost = 0 then sb2cl.estimated_shipping_cost else sb2cl.actual_shipping_cost end as shippingCost, case when sb2cl.actual_shipping_cost = 0 then sb2cl.estimated_shipping_currency else sb2cl.actual_shipping_currency end as shippingCostCurrency, sb2cl.code as logisticsCode, sb2cr.name as buyerName, sb2cr.country_id as countryId, sb2cd.id as detailId, sb2cd.image_url as imageUrl, sb2cd.platform_sku_no as platformSkuNo, sb2cd.seller_sku_no as sellerSkuNo, sb2cd.sku_id as skuId, sb2cd.sku_no as skuNo, sb2cd.tax_cost as taxCost, sb2cd.amount as sourceAmount, sb2cd.currency as sourceCurrency, sb2cd.qty as qty, sb2cd.warehouse_id as warehouseId, sb2cd.warehouse_name as warehouseName sb2cd.warehouse_location as warehouseLocation
mapper.select:
select sb2c.dict_platform as dictPlatform, sb2c.shop_id as shopId, sb2cr.name as buyerName, sb2c.currency, sb2cr.receiver_name, sb2cr.first_address, sb2cd.warehouse_id, sb2cl.dict_logistics_method from so_b2c sb2c inner join so_b2c_detail sb2cd on sb2c.id = sb2cd.main_id and sb2cd.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_logistics sb2cl on sb2c.id = sb2cl.main_id and sb2cl.is_deleted = false inner join so_b2c_receiver sb2cr on sb2c.id = sb2cr.main_id and sb2cr.is_deleted = false
sb2c.is_deleted = false and sb2c.label_json !~ 'AFN' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'U_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'I_TAXED' and sb2cd.label_json !~ 'cainiaoInternationalWarehouse' and not exists (select * from so_b2c_ref sbr where sbr.is_deleted = false and (sbr.source_id = sb2c.id or sbr.target_id = sb2c.id))
and sb2c.code ilike concat('%',#{params.code},'%')
and sb2cr.name ilike concat('%',#{params.buyerName},'%')
and sb2cr.receiver_name ilike concat('%',#{params.receiverName},'%')
and (sb2cr.first_address ilike concat('%',#{params.address},'%') or sb2cr.second_address ilike concat('%',#{params.address},'%') or sb2cr.full_address ilike concat('%',#{params.address},'%'))
and sb2c.dict_platform in
#{item}
and sb2c.shop_id in
#{item}
and sb2c.country_id in
#{item}
${params.permissionSql}
group by sb2c.dict_platform,sb2c.shop_id,sb2cr.name,sb2c.currency,sb2cr.receiver_name,sb2cr.first_address,sb2cd.warehouse_id,sb2cl.dict_logistics_method
